planning_notes: Assumption: No serial behavior was specified in the requirements; therefore no serial_channels and no serial report gating are created.
Control-period selection: set control_period_ms=10 to satisfy the 'input change response <= 20ms' acceptance requirement with at most ~1 step latency.
Analog-to-PWM mapping behavior (0..1023 to 0..255 with rounding tolerance <=1) is implemented in the SysML model, not in port configuration.
Button logic: D2 uses INPUT_PULLUP semantics; model value is true at pressed-state. Physical wiring: pulled-up so pressed corresponds to LOW.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Potentiometer ADC for LED brightness control when button is pressed

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LED PWM brightness (0..255) controlled by potentiometer while button is pressed

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 D2 按钮 + A0 电位器 + D9 LED：按钮按下时电位器控制亮度，否则 LED 关闭
验收约定：D2使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平表示按下；按下时A0的0..1023线性映射到D9的PWM值0..255（取整容差1），松开时输出0。输入变化响应时间不超过20ms。
